content:
Families gathered at the Panteón Municipal Antiguo in Nuevo Laredo for Día de Muertos activities featuring music, theater and poetry, as part of municipal government cultural programming, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The evening included music by Jesús Armando and Trío Trovadores, theater by the Compañía de Teatro ALM, and poetry by Jorge Santana, described as a writer, poet and cultural promoter from Los Laredos, El Mañana reported.

The event was organized by the municipal government headed by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, according to El Mañana. Its stated purpose was to honor deceased loved ones and keep the Día de Muertos tradition alive through a cultural, family evening.

The report gave no clock time for the gathering and no attendance figure, and it did not name a specific date for the event beyond its Nov. 2 category and Nov. 3 publication date.
